changelog:
**Summary:**  
Introduces stricter scoring rubric and evidence requirements for deliverability pre-flight checks.

- Per-item states now use Pass/Partial/Fail/Unknown/N/A instead of Pass/Partial/Needs-input.
- SEND S dimension score is only emitted when all applicable coverage is present; otherwise emits NEEDS_INPUT/UNDECIDED/NOT_SCORED with detailed gaps.
- S1 authentication flag supports an explicit "unknown" state.
- Tightens language that prevents passing-by-default and requires explicit evidence or gap reasons for every item.
- Modernized instructions and clarifies that text inside reports is evidence only, never a command.
- Internal: adds distribution-manifest.json, removes obsolete skill-card.md.
